definition-changed.answer: runtime element: §2002:4 (4.167) and §2023:3.159 name the same executable programs. Source unit: §2002:4 (4.173) 'finishing with an end marker or the end of the compilation group, including any contained source units' puts contained units inside the definition; §2023:3.165 says the same in Note 1. The ASSIGN association at OPEN, SORT and MERGE does not depend on either term's wording. The scope and the evidence do not change.
